scenes.name: 亲妈催婚
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: preview-only concept artwork for a Chinese Android screen-time blocking theme named “亲妈催婚”. Generate one finished landscape 3:2 scene, approximately 1536×1024. This is a new comedic family poster illustration, not code or a UI screenshot.
Primary request: A hilarious, visually loud Chinese family sitcom confrontation when an adult daughter keeps scrolling her phone in bed and her mother arrives to nag about finding a partner. Big theatrical facial expressions, realistic richly rendered people combined with thick black comic outlines, cream speech balloons, red explosion accents and bright yellow emphasis. Like an energetic Chinese meme poster with excellent typography. Warm everyday home setting, NOT fantasy, no cultivation characters.
Scene: medium-close framing of a cozy bedroom at night. At right a Chinese mother in her late 50s, short curly hair with three pink hair rollers, red knitted cardigan and small floral apron, gold bangle, eyebrows dramatically raised, mouth open mid-rant. She leans toward the young woman, one hand tugs ONLY the loose corner of a pink gingham duvet, the other points emphatically toward the phone. At lower left/center a visibly adult Chinese woman around 28, messy bun, cream bear-print pajamas, shoulders covered, sits half upright under the duvet clutching a phone with a small cute cat sticker, guilty side-eye and a single exaggerated blue comic sweat drop. Her deadpan little comeback is the comic payoff. Both characters' expressions and the phone must be large and immediately legible on a mobile screen. Domestic comic exasperation, not real distress or violence.
Composition: upper left has the mother's large cream jagged speech balloon, its tail visibly points to mother at right; adult daughter's face lower center-left, mother face upper right; daughter has smaller round reply balloon near lower left, its tail points to daughter. Keep all words completely inside image with generous padding, no clipped typography. Faces and phone clearly separated from lettering. Background bedside warm lamp and wooden headboard subtly rendered, simple enough for readable subjects.
Text (verbatim, Chinese only, exactly these two speech balloons; no other title):
Mother's big balloon, bold hand-painted Chinese lettering on 3 lines:
“你是准备
跟手机
结婚啊？！”
Use black for first two lines and red for “结婚啊？！” with strong black edging, very readable.
Daughter's smaller reply in black:
“它至少秒回我……”
Style: semi-photoreal cinematic meme/comic painting; realistic skin and fabric texture, expressive funny faces, assertive comic graphic framing, red/yellow/cream/black palette with pink quilt. Mother is comically formidable, daughter comically caught scrolling. A few comic yellow shock rays and a red anger-vein symbol behind the mother. Sharp, professionally finished and visually hilarious.
Constraints: only two people, adult daughter and mother. Anatomically coherent hands, no gripping bodies, no violence, no wedding clothes, no extra portraits, no pigs or babies, no app logo, no watermark, no phone device mockup border, no interface buttons, no timer, no design presentation board. Full-bleed illustration.
